items.name: Pride Clan
items.description: The strongest damage clan in Sailor Piece. Each hit grants 1 stack of heat (0.2% damage per stack), capping at 100 stacks for +20% global damage. Stacks reset after 6 seconds without dealing damage. S-tier for PvP and boss farming.

items.name: Monarch Clan
items.description: The best clan for farming. Every drop has a 20% chance to grant +1 of that drop (mini 2x drop, additive with 2x drop gamepass — max 3 not 4). Combined with +27% Global Damage and +40% HP, Monarch is the top farming clan.

items.name: Voldigoat Clan
items.description: The premier tank clan with +32% Damage, +50% Max HP, and an execute mechanic: enemies under 50% HP receive 25% more damage from you. Best clan for tanky aggressive builds and boss finishing.

items.name: Frostbane Clan
items.description: The newest S+ clan added in the Ice Update (April 8, 2026). Frostbane is currently rated the strongest clan in the game — essential for unlocking the Ice Queen sword's V Move. Provides the highest combined damage and HP of all clans, plus a sword-specific bonus that makes it ideal for sword builds. Requires the Ice Queen sword synergy for maximum potential. Source: Beebom + Pro Game Guides + GuideBros + MrGuider (5+ sources, 2026-04-08).

items.name: Devil Clan
items.description: S+ tier clan from the Anti-Magic Update (April 26, 2026). The best farming clan in the current meta — every drop has a 30% chance to grant +1 of that item. Stats: +42% DMG, +60% Max HP, +12% Sword DMG, +15% Luck. Source: Beebom + sailorpiecewiki (2-source verified R109 2026-05-01).

items.name: Eminence Clan
items.description: A new Legendary clan added in the Massive Update (March 25, 2026). The Eminence Clan is essential for the Atomic Fighting Style F Move — required as part of the 3-quest Atomic Master NPC chain on Lawless Island. Provides +35% DMG, +55% Max HP, +12% Sword Damage, +12% Luck, and a 25% chance to gain an extra drop from any loot source. Source: Beebom (2026-03-26) [provisional].

items.name: Upper Clan
items.description: A new Legendary clan added in the Moon Update (March 31, 2026). Upper is a high-damage melee-focused clan: +40% DMG and +12% Melee DMG make it ideal for melee builds, including the new Moon Slayer spec. Its passive triggers a 25% extra damage burst on every skill use (20% proc rate, 8s duration). Source: Beebom clans guide (2026-04-01).

items.name: Alter Clan
items.description: One of the strongest clans in the game, added in the Alter Update (March 16, 2026). After using 5 abilities (sword, combat style, or fruit), your next ability deals 1.5x damage. Combined with +35% base damage, +50% Max HP, and +10% Melee DMG, Alter rivals Pride and Monarch for top-tier status.

items.name: Mugetsu Clan
items.description: An A-tier survival-focused clan providing a balanced mix of damage, HP, lifesteal, and damage reduction. Mugetsu is the go-to clan for players who want to stay alive in endgame content.

items.name: Espada Clan
items.description: An A-tier clan added in the Huge Update. Every 10th ability/skill used grants a 20% damage boost for 6 seconds. Considered underwhelming by the community compared to S+ clans.

items.name: Yamato Clan
items.description: An A-tier Legendary clan focused on combat and resource farming. Yamato provides +17% Damage, +27% Max HP, and +5% Melee Damage alongside +20% Gems Gain — making it the best mid-game clan for farming Gems needed for fruit spins and weapon purchases. No special passive ability. Source: Beebom + web tier list consensus (2026-03-26).

items.name: Zoldyck Clan
items.description: An A-tier clan with a unique speed focus. Zoldyck provides +15% Damage, +20% Max HP, +20% Sprint Speed, and +15% Gems Gain — a solid early-to-mid game option for players who value mobility and gem income. No special passive ability. Source: Beebom + FandomWire (2026-03-27, double source confirmed).

items.name: Raikage Clan
items.description: A B-tier beginner clan with basic combat bonuses. Raikage is a solid starter clan that provides foundational stats while players save for a Clan Reroll.

items.name: Sasaki Clan
items.description: A B-tier beginner-friendly clan providing +7% Damage, +10% Max HP, and +10% XP Gain. The XP bonus makes Sasaki the best clan for players still leveling up.
